summary: The prior June 2026 index lead is now verified in the full City proposal packet. A Council action record confirms budget adoption with revisions; the reviewed amendments do not explicitly restore Campus. A final Campus-specific funding line and actual closure or relocation remain unverified. claims.claim: The June 23 staff budget packet expressly anticipates discontinuing the Campus Motel shelter program in FY2027 because continuing funding has not been identified and existing funding is scheduled to end.
claims.limits: This is forward-looking budget narrative, not an observed termination, notice, closure date or outcome.

claims.claim: The June 23 annotated agenda records unanimous adoption of Resolution 72,340-N.S., adopting the FY2027/FY2028 budget with specified revised materials and Council changes. It separately records only first reading of the FY2027 appropriations ordinance at that meeting.
claims.limits: A consolidated final Campus-specific line, second-reading ordinance, later amendments and payments were not verified.

claims.claim: No explicit Campus continuation or restoration was found in the two reviewed City Manager supplements or the annotated agenda's listed Council changes. This makes the original funding-discontinuation warning materially stronger than the inherited snippet, while the final Campus-specific appropriation remains unverified.
claims.limits: Not an exhaustive search of every later budget action, contract amendment, accounting system or unextracted content. Do not relabel the original proposal PDF as the final consolidated budget.

claims.claim: The revised FY2027 Community Agency List includes a $1,468,050 Measure P allocation to Insight Housing, along with other agency allocations. It does not name the program served by that amount.
claims.limits: Cannot assign the amount to Campus, treat it as a Campus continuation appropriation, infer spending or calculate cost per person.

counterevidence_and_ordinary_explanation.text: All Home describes Measure P support through June 30, 2027 and 23 rooms. It may describe earlier plans or an interim service period within FY2027; its freshness is unknown. It cannot be resolved into a precise contradiction or present continuity guarantee without a dated funding record.
The City adopted a revised budget rather than the original proposal verbatim. The reviewed revisions do not explicitly restore Campus, but later or differently labeled funding remains possible.
Insight Housing receives a Measure P agency allocation in the revised list. Campus cannot be inferred as the beneficiary because the program label is absent.
The 2023 authorization through 2028 in inherited S-CM03 remains authorization, not guaranteed ongoing funding or proof of current operation.
